title: Progression
description: This is my first public Minecraft plugin! This is meant for SMPs, or players who want to add a slower progression to play the game. This plugin allows you to create multiple progression stages.
body:
# Progression Plugin

This plugin allows you to create multiple stages of progression, with each one being unique with custom messages!

## Purpose:
Adds a slower progression to SMPs, private servers, singleplayer worlds, and more!
**Great for SMPs when you want to give players saturation, set a world border, etc. **
## Capabilities:
- Set the world border (on/off; dimensions; center)
- Give player effects until the next stage
- Create custom messages for different stages
- Create a custom display name per stage
- Toggle the end
- Toggle the nether
- Toggle pvp
- View all commands and info by doing /prog or /progression
- Update your config without restarting the server through /progression reload
